Instrument (EN): Scale of Self-Structure — original 28-item psychodynamic self-organization research edition
Scales / measured domains (EN): Positive Self (9); Self-Center (7); Idealized Identification (5); Vulnerable Self (7). Theoretical higher-order Self-Cathexis and Self-Space Need; four-factor ESEM best, NOT diagnostic categories.
Research provenance: Li X et al., Frontiers in Psychiatry, 2026-09, DOI 10.3389/fpsyt.2026.1942305. Study 1 N1954 initial item development EFA + N128 retest SUBSAMPLE; Study 2 independent N2570 and N1235, total N3805 CFA/ESEM, gender invariance. Started 37 items; retained 28 in 4 correlated factors.
DB locales: No LIVE locale; source-only research metadata.

RU form: No validated RU respondent version found.
ES form: No validated ES respondent version found.

Target population: Mainland China predominantly young nonclinical participants; exploratory development N1954 and independent cross-validation N3805; Sample 3 includes participants aged 9–78, no age-specific or clinical norms established.

Instrument (EN): Caregiver Outcomes of Psychotherapy Evaluation – Individualized Needs and Goals: original 15-item dementia caregiver needs inventory
Scales / measured domains (EN): Pragmatic support; Knowledge and understanding; Behavioral support; Research/program interest (last is a single-item factor). Four exploratory themes with cross-loading; NOT independently confirmed as four robust subscales.
Research provenance: Aguirre A, Samson AE, Tindaan R, Benge JF. BMC Palliative Care 2026-06-08, version of record 2026-08-13; DOI 10.1186/s12904-026-02129-6. Content development interviews/feedback N52 caregivers/professionals, psychometric sample N100 dementia caregivers; four-factor exploratory analysis (66.6% variance), 2-week retest, no independent CFA sample.
EN form: Original US English reported questionnaire, not an independently validated EN translation and not EN-GB.
RU form: No validated Russian questionnaire form found.
ES form: Spanish translation work IN PROGRESS per authors; NO validated ES respondent version shown in 2026 primary study.
Other translations: No validated translations documented in primary publication.
Target population: US caregivers of people living with dementia and mild cognitive impairment, N100 empirical sample + N52 caregivers/professional feedback; not a general wellness questionnaire.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Publisher primary article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: does NOT permit commercial reuse or adaptations through this licence. Full hosted questionnaire items and scoring / digital SaaS licence require rightsholder authorization; clinical sensitivity and caregiving consent apply.
Validated edition evidence / links: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12904-026-02129-6 ; four exploratory EFA themes, pragmatic alpha .859, knowledge .774, behavioral .838, research interest one item (no alpha).
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. 15-item N100 exploratory EFA with cross-loadings; research interest single item should not be labelled validated reliable multi-item subscale; Spanish version underway only.
